paper.title: Online Learning of Rested and Restless Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Rested bandit problem with Markovian rewards and multiple plays
unmapped: Each arm is a finite-state irreducible aperiodic rested Markov chain (state frozen when not played) with unknown state space and transitions; reward is a positive function of the state
Player plays M of K arms per step (m = M); regret against always playing the M arms with highest stationary mean
Multiplicative symmetrizations of transition matrices assumed irreducible (Condition 1)
Exploration constant L must exceed 112 S_max^2 r_max^2 pi_hat_max^2/eps_min, requiring knowledge of a bound on this Markov-chain quantity
settings.definition_quote: The system consists of a single player/user and a set of $K$ finite-state discrete-time Markov chains ({\em arms}) with unknown state spaces and statistics. At each time step the player can play $M$, $M\leq K$, arms. ... the state of a rested arm changes according to $P^i$ only when it is played and remains frozen otherwise.

settings.name_in_paper: Restless bandit problem with Markovian rewards and multiple plays
unmapped: Each arm is a finite-state irreducible aperiodic restless Markov chain (evolves regardless of play); state observed only when played; reward positive function of state
Player plays M of K arms per step (m = M); weak regret against the M best arms by stationary mean
Exploration constant L must exceed 112 S_max^2 r_max^2 pi_hat_max^2/eps_min
settings.definition_quote: By contrast, the state of a restless arm changes according to $P^i$ regardless of the user's actions.

algorithms.name: UCB-M (Upper Confidence Bound - Multiple Plays)
requires_knowledge_of: bound on S_max^2 r_max^2 pi_hat_max^2/eps_min (to set L)

algorithms.name: RCA-M (Regenerative Cycle Algorithm - Multiple Plays)
requires_knowledge_of: bound on S_max^2 r_max^2 pi_hat_max^2/eps_min (to set L)

symbols.L_expl: exploration constant L of the index
symbols.mu_M: mean reward of the M-th best arm
symbols.m: number of plays per step M

conditions: Condition 1: finite-state irreducible aperiodic chains with irreducible multiplicative symmetrizations, positive rewards

source.label: lemma:rev1
source.quote: Under UCB-M with $L \geq 112 S^2_{\max} r^2_{\max} \hat{\pi}^2_{\max} /\epsilon_{\min}$, for any suboptimal arm $i$, we have E[T^i(n)] \leq M + \frac{4L\ln n}{(\mu^{M}-\mu^i)^2} + \sum_{j=1}^M \frac{(|S^i|+|S^{j}|)\beta}{\pi_{\min}}

results.notes: Bound on expected number of plays of a suboptimal arm.

bound.expression: 4*L_expl*log(T)*sum_subopt((mu_1 - mu_i)/(mu_M - mu_i)**2) + sum_subopt((mu_1 - mu_i)*(m + C_i_sum)) + C_SPr

symbols.C_SPr: constant depending on state spaces, transition probabilities, rewards (Lemma 4)
symbols.m: number of plays per step M

source.label: thm:mainrested
source.quote: Assume Condition 1 holds and all arms are rested. With constant $L \geq 112 S^2_{\max} r^2_{\max} \hat{\pi}^2_{\max} /\epsilon_{\min}$ the regret of UCB-M is upper bounded by R(n) \leq 4L\ln n \sum_{i>M} \frac{(\mu^{1}-\mu^i)}{(\mu^{M}-\mu^i)^2} + \sum_{i>M} (\mu^{1}-\mu^i) (M + \sum_{j=1}^M C_{i,j}) + C_{\mathbf{S,P,r}}

results.notes: Regret = n*sum of top-M stationary means minus expected collected reward; classified as pseudo_regret. The paper says strict separation mu^M>mu^{M+1} not needed for rested case.

bound.expression: 4*L_expl*log(T)*sum_subopt(((mu_1 - mu_i)*D_i + E_i)/(mu_M - mu_i)**2) + sum_subopt(((mu_1 - mu_i)*D_i + E_i)*(1 + m*C_i_sum)) + F_const

symbols.D_i: 1/pi^i_min + M^i_max + 1 (M^i_max: max mean hitting time of arm i)
symbols.m: number of plays per step M

source.label: thm:restless1
source.quote: Assume Condition 1 holds and all arms are restless. With constant $L \geq 112 S^2_{\max} r^2_{\max} \hat{\pi}^2_{\max} /\epsilon_{\min}$ the regret of RCA-M is upper bounded by R(n) < 4L \ln n \sum_{i>M} \frac{1}{(\mu^{M}-\mu^i)^2}((\mu^{1}-\mu^i) D_i + E_i) + \sum_{i>M} ((\mu^{1}-\mu^i)D_i+E_i) (1+ M \sum_{j=1}^M C_{i,j}) +F

results.notes: Weak regret vs best M arms by stationary mean. Paper says bound also holds with arbitrary passive dynamics (discussion). Strict inequality in theorem; recorded as exact upper bound.

symbols.m: number of plays per step M

source.label: lemma:restless1
source.quote: Under RCA-M with a constant $L \geq 112 S^2_{\max} r^2_{\max} \hat{\pi}^2_{\max} /\epsilon_{\min}$, we have \sum_{i>M} (\mu^{1}-\mu^i) E[T^i(n)] \leq 4L \sum_{i>M} \frac{(\mu^{1}-\mu^i) D_i \ln n}{(\mu^{M}-\mu^i)^2} + \sum_{i>M} (\mu^{1}-\mu^i) D_i (1 + M \sum_{j=1}^M C_{i,j})

results.notes: Bound on gap-weighted expected plays of suboptimal arms (component of regret).

cited_results.cited_title: Sample mean based index policies with o(log(n)) regret for the multi-armed bandit problem
Learning in a changing world: Non-bayesian restless multi-armed bandit
